title: feat(spec)!: retire page-header-subtitle-alias and inline-action-api-params-to-body-extra from the load path at 18
body:
Fixes #23421

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)

## What

The two ADR-0087 D2 conversions `page-header-subtitle-alias` (`page:header` `properties.description` to `subtitle`) and `inline-action-api-params-to-body-extra` (an inline `type: 'api'` action's object-form `params` to `bodyExtra`) were declared `toMajor: 17` for protocol 17's one-major window. On the `18.0.0-next` line they were still load-active, so `os validate` and the load path converted silently what the metadata save door (once PR #23418 moves the component-props rule onto it) refuses. This PR retires both from the load path, the way every other retired entry is marked: `retiredFromLoadPath: true` and `retiredAfter: '17.7.0'`, the newest published stable release under the `18.0.0-next.0` label.

After this change every door that judges page props answers the same way: `os validate`, `os build`, `os lint`, and the save door after #23418 all refuse the old spelling, and the refusal names the rename. Stored rows keep healing. `applyConversionsToStoredItem` replays the full chain with `includeRetired: true`, so does the artifact-ingestion door inside its window, and `os migrate meta` replays the chain too.

## Premise check (done before any edit)

- ADR-0087 D2, "Window": "each conversion is applied by the loader for one major (N accepts N-1 shapes at load), then retired from the load path in N+1". `toMajor: 17` means 18 is N+1. The section "The load-window's second half is now mechanical" names `MetadataConversion.retiredFromLoadPath` as the field that implements that retirement.
- `conversions/types.ts`: `RetiredConversionState` is `retiredFromLoadPath: true` plus a required `retiredAfter`. `apply.ts` skips such an entry unless `includeRetired` is set. `stored.ts` pins `includeRetired: true`.
- Precedent: at `61b12584f`, 45 `toMajor: 17` entries carry `retiredFromLoadPath` (`retiredAfter` 16.1.0). Among the `toMajor: 18` entries, 69 are retired, 7 of them with `retiredAfter: '17.7.0'` (for example `declared-index-unique-scope` and `email-template-category-is-system-removed`).
- The premise holds, so this PR takes the retirement route. It does not touch the other route (the save door applying live-window conversions).

## Changes

- `packages/spec/src/conversions/registry.ts`: the two entries get the two fields, and their docblocks now record the retirement in place of "Live window; retires at 18".
- `packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts`: `PageHeaderProps` `description` moves from an `aliases` row (a bare "Did you mean `description` to `subtitle`?") to a `guidance` row. It is the upgrade prescription in house form: it names `@objectstack/spec 18` and `subtitle`, followed by the `os migrate meta --from 16` house sentence.
- `packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts`: the object-form `params` refusal keeps its `bodyExtra` instruction. It now also says the loader rewrote that form on an inline page button until `@objectstack/spec 18`, and it ends in the MIXED two-clause `os migrate meta --from 16` sentence. The partial form is used because the conversion only covers the inline `element:button` case.
  - Why these two text edits are here although the claim's file surface does not name `ui/*.zod.ts`: `shared/retired-key-removal-version.pin.test.ts` requires every entry retired after the newest stable release to be joined to the prescriptions an author meets, and requires each of those prescriptions to name the derived release (18). Neither refusal named a release, so the pin went red on exactly these two ids. The landing spot is the producer of the refusal text, in the same package.
- Pin flips (load-bearing, not just deletions):
  - `conversions/conversions.test.ts`: the two entries' rewrite cases run the data-at-rest posture (`includeRetired: true`). New cases assert that the authoring posture rewrites nothing on both `page:header` and the kebab `page-header`, and on the object-form `params`. They also assert the entry fields (`toMajor: 17`, `retiredFromLoadPath: true`, `retiredAfter: '17.7.0'`) and that the `bodyExtra` refusal is what an author meets. The premise pin on `PageHeaderProps` (refuses `description`, names `subtitle`) stays verbatim.
  - `lint/src/validate-component-props.test.ts`: the "normalized tier" block asserted the normalized tier says nothing about `description`. It now asserts that the normalized tier refuses it as `component-props-unknown-key`, `error`, at the exact path, naming `subtitle`, and that the raw tier gives the same answer.
  - `shared/retired-key-removal-version.pin.test.ts`: two JOIN rows.
- Vehicle swaps: `spec/src/stack-conversions-record.test.ts`, `cli/test/stack-conversion-record-door.test.ts` and `cli/src/commands/validate-json-strict-exit.e2e.test.ts` used `page-header-subtitle-alias` as their live conversion. Their own docblocks said to re-point them at a live entry when it retired. They now ride `page-component-visibility-to-visibleWhen` (`visibility` to `visibleWhen` on the same `page:header` node, `retiresIn: 16`), and every assertion is unchanged in substance.
- `.changeset/23421-retire-page-aliases-at-18.md`: `minor`, with the **BREAKING** banner, `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`, the FROM to TO mapping, and the ADR-0087 disposition. In words, the disposition marker is "adr-0087: not-required (already-registered page-header-subtitle-alias, inline-action-api-params-to-body-extra)". Both conversions are already in the step-17 chain and are the whole mechanical migration, so there is no new D2 conversion and no D3 semantic entry. `check-adr-0087-registration` accepts it.

## For the seat: one sentence in PR #23418 becomes false

PR #23418's changeset `.changeset/23388-page-component-rules-runtime-door.md` carries the paragraph that begins "Two live-window ADR-0087 D2 aliases ... are converted at `objectstack validate` and at load but not at this door". Once this PR lands, that paragraph is false: neither alias is converted at `objectstack validate` or at load any more. This PR does not edit #23418's files. The same goes for the comment block in `packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts` (the `validateComponentProps` entry, "`normalized` for a reason worth stating ..."), which still cites `page-header-subtitle-alias` as the converted alias that makes the tier matter. That file is in #23418's diff, so it is left for that landing. #23418 is not addressed here.

## Verification (at `6f0fcb21f`, after merging `origin/main` at `3d231ba78`)

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: 676 files, 20576 tests passed (after the merge).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test:repo`: 59 files, 1011 tests passed (before the merge, which touched no tree-scoped pin input of this diff).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: all 14 generated artifacts up to date.
- Before the merge: `typecheck`: `@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/lint` and `@objectstack/cli` each exit 0.
- `@objectstack/lint` full vitest, `@objectstack/cli` `--project unit` (287 files, 4307 tests), and the two touched CLI integration and e2e files: `test/stack-conversion-record-door.test.ts` (21/21) and `src/commands/validate-json-strict-exit.e2e.test.ts` under `OS_TEST_TIERS=nightly` (7/7).
- Red before the flip: with only the registry edit applied, `conversions.test.ts` had 5 failing cases and `stack-conversions-record.test.ts` had 30, all asserting the two conversions ran on the authoring path. The lint tier case and the removal-version pin each went red the same way.
- The gate families came from `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (93 families, the same set before and after the merge). All 93 were run at `6f0fcb21f` with exit 0, and the list was reconciled with `--ran`.

## Acceptance notes

- `page-header` (kebab): the conversion's walk still lists it, for the data-at-rest replays. Retired, a source `page-header` node's `description` is neither converted nor judged, because `ComponentPropsMap` has no `page-header` row. This is harmless: objectui at the pinned `.objectui-sha` no longer registers `page-header` (its components changeset "drop `page-header` from the opt-in protocol placeholders"), so such a node renders the unknown-component panel whatever its props say.
- The boot path loading source through `defineStack` does not run the props gate (that gate runs at `os validate` / `os build` / `os lint` and, after #23418, at the save door). This is the same posture every other retired page prop already has (`page:header` `icon` and `breadcrumb`).
- In-repo authors of either old spelling: zero (`examples/`, `packages/platform-objects`, `packages/plugins`, `packages/services`). The control grep on `page:header` finds the canonical `subtitle` in use.
